title: Weekly Market Wrap: NIFTY50, SENSEX rise 2%, SMIDs shine, Nifty India Defence jumps nearly 7%; Trent tops list
quote: The lesson is rarely in the noise; it is in what the market chose to reprice.
lesson: Use yesterday's market news as a question, not an instruction. Ask what changed, whether it is temporary, and whether the price has already reacted before you act.
